clue.text: Plant cattle enjoy, one with blend of sugar and salt

indicators.note: a blend mixes its ingredients together, so the letters that follow are stirred into a new order

taken as written
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: The 'one' goes into the mix too, so ten letters are shuffled. ASTRAGALUS is the milk-vetch genus, a forage plant for grazing stock.
explanation.definitionFit: Astragalus, the milk vetch, is a legume grazed by livestock, so the extended description identifies the genus.
